attributes.title: Circle continuity
attributes.lede: One mounted cast, two coordinate levels, one repeating score.

lesson.why: Stable circles retain their identity as a parent zoom and local rearrangements combine.
lesson.experiment: Change grid spacing first, then zoom. Compare the local spacing with its magnified screen distance.
lesson.pitfall: Repeating a tween does not repeat its enclosing sequence. Every track here contains a complete cycle.
lesson.combine: Use the same parent-and-child separation to connect a data overview with a detail view.
